limitations_and_boundaries: The negative correlation between collagen density and CD8+ T cell abundance in breast cancer samples did not reach statistical significance due to limited sample size (n=20).
The study primarily uses in vitro 3D collagen matrices, which may not fully recapitulate the complex tumor microenvironment in vivo.
T cell stimulation in most experiments was performed with PMA/ionomycin, bypassing TCR signaling, which may not reflect physiological activation.
The cytotoxicity assays were performed with a single patient-derived T cell and melanoma line (MM33), limiting generalizability.
The study does not directly demonstrate that collagen density-induced T cell modulation occurs in vivo or affects tumor progression.

research_questions.statement: Does collagen density in the tumor microenvironment directly regulate T cell activity and anti-tumor function?
